description.zh: 可调网格、字体、液态玻璃与动态波形的桌面资源监视窗
description.en: A configurable desktop resource monitor with an adaptive grid, typography, liquid glass and dynamic sparklines

description.zh: 查看 CPU、内存、GPU、磁盘和网络的实时数值；显示或隐藏监视窗
description.en: Live CPU, memory, GPU, disk and network readings; show or hide the monitor

hint.zh: 监视窗 / 数值；Enter 显示或隐藏监视窗
hint.en: monitor / values; Enter shows or hides the monitor

hint.zh: 悬浮在所有窗口之上，不抢焦点；隐藏时不再采样
hint.en: Floats above every window without taking focus; sampling stops while hidden

hint.zh: 500 – 5000 毫秒；控制系统指标和波形历史的更新，不影响玻璃背景和动画
hint.en: 500–5000 ms between metric and history samples; independent of glass capture and animation

hint.zh: 单行文字，28px 行高；下方自动图高 6px。内边距独立设置，尺寸随整体缩放
hint.en: Single-line text, 28px rows and automatic 6px bottom charts. Padding is independent; dimensions follow scale

hint.zh: 80–200；整体缩放文字、格子、内边距和波形
hint.en: 80–200; scales text, cells, padding and charts together

hint.zh: 贴到显示器边缘后收起，移入触发条展开
hint.en: Collapse at a display edge and expand from its trigger strip

hint.zh: 停在非贴边位置并离开后按延时收起
hint.en: Collapse after leaving a non-edge panel for the configured delay

hint.zh: 点击穿过监视窗；从 sys 搜索或设置窗口恢复
hint.en: Clicks pass through; recover from sys search or the settings window
